item.title: 04-02 Vulnerability Point. Economic Overload
item.description: This work diagnoses the economic overload of authoritarian rule. Repression consumes resources without creating value, and the regime gradually exhausts its own foundations. Tyranny eventually becomes more expensive than society can sustain.
